description: This Java interface 'ScopedConfig' extends configuration handling with additional methods for retrieving non-negative durations and positive integers, and includes documentation and example usage related to configuration paths within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: getNonNegativeDurationOrThrow
methods.description: Returns a non-negative Duration from the config path, throws DittoConfigError if the duration is negative.

methods.name: getPositiveIntOrThrow
methods.description: Returns a positive integer from the config path, throws DittoConfigError if the value is zero or negative.
